recommendation: Retain the adaptive stale-cache backfill repair, do not restart live execution from this report, and load the repaired bytes at the next controlled observer generation after the open ETH report-only lifecycle resolves.

independent_observer_corroboration.interpretation: An independently configured V58 observer using the same frozen poller and HYPE alignment collector stopped at the same outage recovery boundary. This is corroborating chronology, not a retained traceback.

causal_chain: The frozen V57 poller used the full configured lookback only for its first fetch and exactly five minutes for every later fetch.
The four exhausted transport cycles left the retained one-minute cache approximately thirteen minutes behind the recovery observation.
The recovery fetch could cover only the newest five minutes, leaving a missing interval between the retained cache and the recovered tail.
V57 configured the HYPE alignment provider, which delegates to the canonical completed-bar regime builder.
The canonical regime builder requires exact one-minute open-time cadence and raises ValueError when the merged frame contains that hole.
The runtime ledger shows the terminal exception after the outage and before a new intent-routing record, consistent with failure inside intent polling.

reproduction.method: Run the exact HYPE alignment collector through ConfiguredMultiAssetIntentPoller with a contiguous fourteen-day source, an initial poll, a twelve-minute interruption, and either the frozen five-minute or repaired adaptive recovery lookback.

frozen_result.exception_message: 1m regime bars require exact 1m open-time cadence

repair.behavior: Compute a per-symbol recovery lookback from the age of the newest retained one-minute bar, add one overlap minute, enforce the normal five-minute minimum, and cap at configured retention.

operational_state.reason_not_restarted_now: The preregistered ETH lifecycle is unresolved and bound to the current observer run identity; restarting would contaminate that experiment.
operational_state.next_safe_reload: After the ETH lifecycle resolves, stop the report-only observer normally, start a new observer generation with repaired bytes, rebind its checkpoint and lifecycle watchers, and verify a fresh identity before using its evidence.

uncertainties: The original traceback was not durably retained, so the exact production stack frame cannot be compared byte-for-byte with the reproduction.
Earlier ValueError faults in older profile generations may have different causes and are not reclassified by this artifact.
The current long-running V58 observer predates the repair and therefore is not operational proof of the repaired process.
falsifiers: A retained V57 traceback identifies a different failure stage or exception message.
The frozen poller completes the exact outage/recovery sequence with the configured HYPE collector and a demonstrable candle hole.
A new process loaded from the repaired source reproduces the cadence ValueError while its recovered one-minute input is complete and contiguous.
The current adaptive recovery request fails to overlap the newest retained bar for an outage shorter than configured retention.

confidence.basis: Frozen-source diff, exact live-ledger chronology, independent observer-stop corroboration, actual-provider reproduction with the same exception class and cadence message, repaired-path counterfactual PASS, and a focused regression test.
confidence.limitation: High confidence is not mathematical certainty because the production traceback is absent.
